UpdateSourceArgs: -c "echo 'Initialising Wine prefix (existing prefix and saves are preserved)...'; WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all /usr/bin/wineboot --init --update && echo 'Wine prefix ready.'"

-c "mkdir -p \"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine/drive_c/users/amp/Documents/Dyson Sphere Program/Save\"; ln -sfn \".wine/drive_c/users/amp/Documents/Dyson Sphere Program/Save\" \"{{$FullRootDir}}Save\"; echo 'Save folder is visible in File Manager at: dysonsphereprogram/Save'"

-c "set -e; cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; echo 'Unpacking Goldberg...'; rm -rf _goldberg && mkdir -p _goldberg && 7z x -y goldberg.7z -o_goldberg >/dev/null; DLL=$(find _goldberg -path '*regular/x64/steam_api64.dll' | head -n1); if [[ -z \"$DLL\" ]]; then echo 'ERROR: steam_api64.dll (regular/x64) not found in Goldberg archive'; exit 1; fi; cp -f \"$DLL\" \"{{$FullBaseDir}}steam_api64.dll\" && echo 'Installed Goldberg steam_api64.dll'; mkdir -p \"{{$FullBaseDir}}steam_settings\"; echo '1366540' > \"{{$FullBaseDir}}steam_settings/steam_appid.txt\"; echo 'Wrote steam_settings/steam_appid.txt (1366540)'; rm -rf _goldberg goldberg.7z; echo 'Goldberg install complete.'"

-c "set -e; cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"; if [[ -d _bepinex_tmp/BepInExPack ]]; then cp -rf _bepinex_tmp/BepInExPack/* ./; else cp -rf _bepinex_tmp/* ./; fi; rm -rf _bepinex_tmp; mkdir -p BepInEx/plugins BepInEx/config; echo 'BepInEx installed (winhttp.dll + BepInEx/ present).'"

-c "cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && mkdir -p BepInEx/config BepInEx/plugins/nebula-NebulaMultiplayerModApi BepInEx/plugins/nebula-NebulaMultiplayerMod BepInEx/plugins/PhantomGamers-IlLine BepInEx/plugins/starfi5h-ErrorAnalyzer BepInEx/plugins/starfi5h-NebulaCompatibilityAssist BepInEx/plugins/starfi5h-BulletTime && echo 'Plugin directories ready.'"

UpdateStageName: [9/9] Seed default nebula.cfg (your settings are applied on start)
UpdateSourceData:
[Nebula - Settings]

ServerPassword = 
HostPort = {{$GamePort}}
RemoteAccessEnabled = false
RemoteAccessPassword = 
AutoPauseEnabled = true

DYSON SPHERE PROGRAM + NEBULA - SERVER README
=============================================

GETTING A WORLD ONTO THE SERVER:
  - The headless server can LOAD a save but cannot reliably CREATE a new
    galaxy itself (new-game needs the game's full boot, which currently
    fails under the Goldberg Steam emulator). So prepare the world on a PC:
      1. On your PC, in DSP (with Nebula installed), start a new game,
         play a few seconds, and Save it (e.g. name it 'server').
      2. Upload the save file(s) (server.dsv, and server.moddsv if present)
         via AMP File Manager into the visible shortcut folder:
         dysonsphereprogram/Save/
         (this links to the real save folder hidden inside .wine)
      3. Set World Mode = 'Load latest save' (or 'Load specific save' and
         put the name in Save Name) and Start.
  - SWAPPING WORLDS: upload multiple saves to that folder, then set World
    Mode = 'Load specific save' and type the save name (no .dsv) in Save Name.

CONNECTING (clients):
  - Every player MUST run the SAME Nebula version as this server
    (see VERSIONS.md / the 'Nebula Version' setting). Install Nebula via
    r2modman or Thunderstore Mod Manager, then in DSP main menu choose
    Multiplayer -> Join, and enter:  <this-server-ip>:{{$GamePort}}
  - Open/forward TCP port {{$GamePort}} to this server.

SAVING (IMPORTANT):
  - Clean-shutdown auto-save is UNRELIABLE under Wine. Before you Stop or
    Restart the server, save manually:
      1. In-game chat:  /server login <Remote Admin Password>
      2. Then:          /server save
    (Enable 'Remote Admin' + set the password in the Configuration tab.)

SAVES LOCATION:
  Visible shortcut (use this in File Manager):  dysonsphereprogram/Save/
  Real path:  dysonsphereprogram/.wine/drive_c/users/amp/Documents/Dyson Sphere Program/Save/

UPDATING THE MOD STACK:
  - See VERSIONS.md in the template repo. Bump the version fields in the
    Configuration tab (or the defaults in the repo) and re-run Update.
    Keep DSP and Nebula in lockstep.
